senses.gloss:
Pluṣ is the name of some noxious insect in the Rigveda. It is also included in the list of victims at the aśvamedha (‘horse sacrifice’) in the yajurveda Saṃhitās, and is mentioned in the Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad. Possibly a species of ant may be meant.
Foot notes i. 191, 1.
Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 8; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 20.
i. 3, 24.
Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 98.
